plan.title: Confirm the migration is not already applied
commands: npx wrangler d1 execute trace-manifest-db-preview --remote --json --command "SELECT 'table' AS kind, name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('email_outbox', 'newsletter_signup_attempts', 'newsletter_subscribers') UNION ALL SELECT 'index' AS kind, name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name IN ('idx_email_outbox_due', 'idx_email_outbox_subscriber', 'idx_newsletter_subscribers_status');"
plan.expect: no rows; any row means it is (partly) applied: STOP and inspect

plan.title: Record a Time Travel bookmark
commands: npx wrangler d1 time-travel info trace-manifest-db-preview --json
plan.expect: record the bookmark in the receipt; it is for a separately approved last-resort restore only

plan.title: Record baseline counts and the release snapshot
commands: npx wrangler d1 execute trace-manifest-db-preview --remote --json --command "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story_clusters) AS story_clusters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story_cluster_members) AS story_cluster_members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_items) AS feed_items, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM editorial_candidates) AS editorial_candidates, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_audit_log) AS admin_audit_log;"
npx wrangler d1 execute trace-manifest-db-preview --remote --json --file scripts/ops/release-snapshot.sql

plan.title: Apply the migration (only with the owner's approval of this exact manifest)
plan.expect: sha256 57f990622190f3463df2f9aacd7cfc5d7867cc095f3dcf5f8d1fedd10d968799 before applying; any error: STOP and use the recovery notes
recovery: a full re-run completes the migration

plan.title: Check the resulting schema
commands: npx wrangler d1 execute trace-manifest-db-preview --remote --json --command "SELECT 'table' AS kind, name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('email_outbox', 'newsletter_signup_attempts', 'newsletter_subscribers') UNION ALL SELECT 'index' AS kind, name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name IN ('idx_email_outbox_due', 'idx_email_outbox_subscriber', 'idx_newsletter_subscribers_status');"

npx wrangler d1 execute trace-manifest-db-preview --remote --json --command "SELECT 1 FROM newsletter_subscribers UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM email_outbox UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM newsletter_signup_attempts LIMIT 1"
plan.expect: 6 object rows; postflight queries as declared

plan.title: Verify data preservation
commands: npx wrangler d1 execute trace-manifest-db-preview --remote --json --command "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story_clusters) AS story_clusters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM story_cluster_members) AS story_cluster_members, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feed_items) AS feed_items, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM editorial_candidates) AS editorial_candidates, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_audit_log) AS admin_audit_log;"
npx wrangler d1 execute trace-manifest-db-preview --remote --json --command "PRAGMA foreign_key_check;"
npx wrangler d1 execute trace-manifest-db-preview --remote --json --file scripts/ops/release-snapshot.sql
plan.expect: counts identical to step 4; no foreign-key rows (PRAGMA quick_check fails with SQLITE_NOMEM on D1; do not use it); compare snapshots with release-verify.mjs

plan.title: Record the postflight receipt
plan.expect: attach outputs, bookmark and approval to the execution manifest

last_resort: A whole-database Time Travel restore (wrangler d1 time-travel restore) can erase unrelated writes made after the bookmark. It is never part of this plan and needs its own owner approval.
note: This file is a plan. Nothing in TRACE-OPS-01 executes it.
